mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM polls poll WHERE poll.use_yn = 'Y'
AND CASE WHEN poll.poll_status = 'OPEN' AND COALESCE(poll.ends_at, DATE_ADD(poll.created_at, INTERVAL 60 MINUTE)) <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE poll.poll_status END = #{status}

SELECT poll.poll_id, poll.question, poll.poll_status, poll.allow_multiple, poll.max_selections, poll.realtime_results, poll.ends_at, poll.result_published_at, poll.created_by, member.member_name AS creator_name, poll.created_at FROM polls poll JOIN members member ON member.member_id = poll.created_by WHERE poll.poll_id = #{pollId} AND poll.use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT poll.poll_id, poll.question, poll.poll_status, poll.allow_multiple, poll.max_selections, poll.realtime_results, poll.ends_at, poll.result_published_at, poll.created_by, member.member_name AS creator_name, poll.created_at FROM polls poll JOIN members member ON member.member_id = poll.created_by WHERE poll.poll_id = #{pollId} AND poll.use_yn = 'Y' FOR UPDATE

SELECT poll_option.poll_option_id, poll_option.option_label, poll_option.sort_order, COUNT(selection.poll_ballot_selection_id) AS vote_count FROM poll_options poll_option LEFT JOIN poll_ballot_selections selection ON selection.poll_option_id = poll_option.poll_option_id WHERE poll_option.poll_id = #{pollId} GROUP BY poll_option.poll_option_id, poll_option.option_label, poll_option.sort_order ORDER BY poll_option.sort_order, poll_option.poll_option_id

SELECT selection.poll_option_id FROM poll_ballots ballot JOIN poll_ballot_selections selection ON selection.poll_ballot_id = ballot.poll_ballot_id WHERE ballot.poll_id = #{pollId} AND (ballot.visitor_key = #{visitorKey} OR ballot.member_id = #{memberId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poll_ballots WHERE poll_id = #{pollId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poll_ballots (poll_id, visitor_key, member_id) VALUES (#{pollId}, #{visitorKey}, #{memberId})

INSERT INTO polls (question, poll_status, allow_multiple, max_selections, realtime_results, ends_at, created_by) VALUES (#{question}, 'OPEN', #{allowMultiple}, #{maxSelections}, #{realtimeResults}, #{endsAt}, #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO poll_options (poll_id, option_label, sort_order) VALUES (#{pollId}, #{optionLabel}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE polls SET poll_status = #{status}, result_published_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RESULTS_PUBLISHED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE result_published_at END WHERE poll_id = #{pollId}
UPDATE polls SET use_yn = 'N', deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE poll_id = #{pollId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
